title: Shared shelter quiet conflict reset
summary: A de-escalation routine for shelters, crowded homes, gyms, or ferry waiting areas when noise, lights, phones, children, or fatigue create conflict.
content: Core sequence: 1) Lower the number of speakers before solving the complaint; one calm representative speaks for each side. 2) Move the most noise-sensitive person or exhausted caregiver away from the argument first. 3) Set a short quiet window with exceptions for medical needs, official alerts, infants, and safety checks. 4) Write the window publicly so the same argument is not restarted every hour.
